I’d recommend maintaining a 1-2 day finished goods buffer at a nearby node and submitting updated requests early. Let’s focus on increasing firm bookings for top customers from 20% to 25%.

For the remaining volumes, I can submit them as flexible but reclassify mid-tier SKUs within growing families to "protected-flex," which gives them higher priority for reallocation. To raise priority, I'd suggest using flexible requests with narrower time windows, consistent with contract terms. For intermittently tight corridors, I want to proactively shift noncritical flows to alternate lanes and consolidate SKUs to free up lane slots. I think capping premium spending at 3-5% of total shipments will help protect margins.

I recommend maintaining a 1-2 day finished goods buffer at a nearby node for quick replacements and rescheduling flexibility.
